# DSH Isolated Runtime

Kubernetes-native isolated execution for one exact DSH baseline. Not a DSH plugin.

- [Local installation for AI assistants](docs/ai/local-run.md)
- [Human quickstart](docs/quickstart.md)
- [Chinese quickstart](docs/quickstart.zh-CN.md)
- [Distribution, networks and release gates](docs/distribution.md)
- [Architecture](docs/specs/architecture.md)
- [Threat model](docs/specs/threat-model.md)
- [Contributor instructions](AGENTS.md)

Use the documents shipped with the selected release. Do not treat main as a
published version. Never delete user data, request model credentials in chat,
or operate an existing cluster without explicit user direction.
